title: Started out nice, then fell apart
text: Started out nice, then fell apart. I started out liking this blanket, then needed to change my review. I washed it in gentle cycle only twice and the gray hem is now coming off. That is ridiculous. This is a nice, soft blanket but should not come apart so quickly. I am sick that this could end up in trash, but I do not want a torn blanket on my bed either. I hope they recycle it at least.
